page.notes: The page number "54" is printed at top left, with a stray mark after it that may be a fault, so it is doubtful. The Greek line is read with uncertainty in the middle word (συνυπεκρίθησαν); it is marked [?] at the end of the line, not in the word. The Greek opening "καὶ" was printed in a form close to Latin letters; it is read as Greek. The faint line above the title rules is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The right-hand edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
